title: Nightly build 20171203 failing to receive transmitter readings
symptom: When trying to start a new sensor, xDrip+ appears to hang in the receive three sensor readings state and can take a long time to progress to calibration, sometimes never doing so. It hung like this for 24 hours and took a reinstall and six hour wait before it would calibrate. Following calibration, it only took readings every ten minutes and then lost connectivity and wouldn’t reconnect.
cause: The issue appears to be affected by Android Wear. When Wear is installed, even without a watch connected, even if xDrip+ is not set to use Wear, it loses connectivity to the transmitter. As soon as Wear is uninstalled, everything works.
fix: Uninstall Android Wear (or avoid having it installed) to restore connectivity. The user also found that a clean uninstall and forget of all watches helped, but reinstalling Wear caused issues again.
